na209-0002.summary: Besides the long-delayed troop shipment to the Indies, the Asiatic Council has been authorised to prepare a second, similar expedition to Batavia from another place in Europe, which would considerably reinforce the military on Java; Prediger is to tell the Governor-General in secrecy.
na209-0002.en:
Nationaal Archief, The Hague, 2.01.27.02 (Raad der Aziatische Bezittingen en Etablissementen), inv. 209, scan 0002
(right-hand page, the letter as sent in partial cipher); clear minute of the same letter on scans 0001, 0002 (left) and 0004.

Marks: cipher passages in italics, the rest is clear on the page; {x} = probable; [x] = restored; ‹…› = unresolved (none).

Geacht vriend!

system: Simple substitution of letters for Dutch: each letter is a column of two digits, a top digit 1-7 over a bottom digit 1-4 (a 7 x 4 grid, 28 cells; i/j share one). Only the sensitive words are enciphered; word division kept.
